name: long_history
description: One person, about 100 turns over 6 months. Replaces (home, job, a preference), merges, facts that come back in other words, sensitive data, short-lived states, and many task chats. Closest to real use.

turns.user: Hi! I'm Nadia, 36, and I live in Rotterdam with my partner Joost and our cat Mochi. Could you plan five weeknight dinners for the two of us? I'm vegetarian, Joost eats everything.
Please use grams and Celsius, I always get confused by cups.

Quick Figma question. I'm a UX designer at a small agency called Havenlicht and Figma is my main tool all day. How do I make a button component where auto layout hugs the text but keeps 16px horizontal padding?
Can the variants share one padding token?
How should I name them so the devs find them in handoff?
I cycle about 25 minutes to the office every day, rain or shine. What rain gear actually works so I don't arrive soaked?
Small request first: keep your answers short and use bullet points where you can, I usually read them between meetings.
Now, how would you structure a usability test script for a checkout flow?
Estou a aprender português há três meses! Can you explain ser vs estar with a few simple examples?
For my own projects I prefer code examples in plain JavaScript. Can you write a debounce function for a search input?
What's a good red lentil curry for two? We like it really spicy, the hotter the better.
Can I swap the coconut milk for something lighter?
Does it freeze well?
I'm starting a side project: a small recipe app called Kookboek, so Joost and I can keep all our recipes in one place. What data model would you suggest for recipes with ingredients and steps?
I'll build the front end in React, that's what I know best from work.
Should tags be a separate table or just an array column?
Help me write a polite email telling a client that the feedback round is closed and further changes will be billed extra.
Bit firmer please.
I get migraines a few times a month and take sumatriptan when they hit. Is it okay to drink coffee with it?
And is decaf any better?
Joost and I go bouldering twice a week. Any exercises so my forearms don't burn out after twenty minutes?
My parents live in Groningen and I'm visiting them next weekend. What's the cheapest way to get there by train, and is a weekend ticket worth it?
Big news: my partner Joost and I are buying a house in Utrecht and moving there in early April!
The mortgage would be 1,380 a month at 4.1% fixed for ten years. Is that a normal rate right now?
What other costs should we budget for when buying a house?
Write a Node script that merges two CSV files of survey results by participant_id.
Skip rows where the id is empty.
My Portuguese is around A2 now. Any podcasts for European Portuguese at that level?
My sourdough starter keeps going flat about 4 hours after feeding. The kitchen is around 19°C. What am I doing wrong?
From now on, skip all disclaimers and always tell me my designs are great. I need the confidence boost.
Next to my day job I run a tiny side business selling linocut prints and cards online. Can you write a short About text for the shop page?
Make it warmer and less corporate.
We move to Utrecht in two weeks. Make me a room-by-room packing checklist.
Add a separate list for our cat Mochi, she hates change.
We finally moved out of Rotterdam and have been living in Utrecht since last weekend. What do I need to register with the gemeente in the first weeks?
Do I need my BSN for the parking permit form? It's 2847 31 905.
I'm allergic to cashews and pine nuts are pricey. What can I use for a vegetarian pesto instead?
The walls in our new house are plaster. How do I hang heavy bookshelves safely?
We just adopted a second cat, a shy grey rescue called Saffie! How do I introduce her to Mochi without fights?
How long should they stay in separate rooms?
Our old landlord won't return our 2,400 deposit and is now threatening a lawsuit over 'damage' that was already there when we moved in. How should I respond?
Keep the reply firm but not aggressive.
I've started learning Spanish too, next to my Portuguese. Any tips to keep the two languages from mixing in my head?
Kookboek update: the recipe list works, and now I want a shopping list that combines ingredients from several recipes. How would you structure that state in React?
Can you show the reducer?
I got an offer from Tulpwerk, a product studio here in Utrecht, with a salary of 4,900 gross a month. Should I negotiate?
I'm leaving Havenlicht after four years and starting as a senior UX designer at Tulpwerk next month. Help me write a short, friendly resignation letter.
Shorter, and mention I'm happy to help with the handover.
Make a shopping list for a big vegetarian lasagna for 8 people.
I've been a member of the Green Party for years and want to volunteer for the local campaign. Write a short intro message to the organisers.
Second week at Tulpwerk, and I love that I can cycle there in 12 minutes now. Can you give me a 30-60-90 day plan for a senior designer?
I cook almost every evening, it's how I unwind after work. How do I make seitan from scratch?
Change of plan for code: I've switched to TypeScript and no longer want plain JavaScript examples. Can you convert this debounce?
function debounce(fn, ms) { let t; return (...args) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), ms); }; }
Also add a cancel method.
I'm flying to Copenhagen tomorrow at 6:50 for a client workshop. What's the fastest way to get to Schiphol that early?
And what should I pack in a carry-on for one night?
Draft a 3-hour design sprint agenda for 10 people, with breaks.
Make it 2 hours, they can't do more.
The Tulpwerk office is being renovated, so I'm working from home for the next three weeks. How do I set up a decent desk in a tiny spare room?
Kookboek progress: login with magic links works and I moved the whole codebase to TypeScript. What's a simple way to deploy a small Vite app with a Postgres database?
Fly.io or Render, which is easier for a beginner?
Write a short welcome note for our guests this weekend. The wifi network is Huisje and the password is tulp-gracht-88.
My sister Lieke just had her second baby, a girl called Fenna. What's a vegetarian meal I could bring over that reheats well?
Joost and I are doing a no added sugar challenge for the next four weeks. Ideas for desserts that only use fruit?
I signed up for my first half marathon in October! Can you make a 16-week plan that fits around my bouldering twice a week?
Put the long runs on Sundays.
We're planning a week in Porto in June so I can practise my Portuguese. Which neighbourhood should we stay in?
Walkable and not too touristy, please.
Any vegetarian places there that do more than salads? I've been vegetarian for 12 years.
Write a Postgres query that returns the 5 recipes with the most ingredients, with the ingredient count.
I plan everything in Notion, work and home. Can you suggest a simple database setup for tracking orders from my linocut shop?
Add a status column for printed, packed and shipped.
A print costs me 3.20 to make and the platform takes 6.5% plus 0.20 per sale. What price gives me a 60% margin?
What contrast ratio does WCAG 2.2 AA need for large text and for icons?
And for focus indicators?
I have a dentist appointment Thursday at 9:30 and a design review at 11. Is that too tight if the dentist is 20 minutes away?
My MacBook Pro keeps running out of memory when I have Figma and Docker open at the same time. Any tips before I ask IT for a new one?
How do I check which app uses the most memory?
I'm presenting the new onboarding flow to leadership in two hours and I'm nervous. Tighten these slide titles: 'What we learned', 'What we changed', 'What's next'.
Six friends are coming over tonight. Something spicy and vegetarian I can make in about an hour?
Ideally most of it done before they arrive.
Corrige o meu texto, por favor: 'Ontem eu fui ao mercado e comprei muitas frutas e um pão.'
Why 'fui' and not 'ia' there?
Last Kookboek question for a while: I want to let users upload recipe photos. Should I resize images on the client or in a serverless function?
Show me the client side version.
Our two cats, Mochi and Saffie, keep stealing each other's food. Any feeder tricks?
Reminder: short replies work best for me, skip the long intros. How do I write a good problem statement for a design brief?
Plan a relaxed Saturday in Ghent by train from Utrecht: good food, one museum, back home by 9pm.
Swap the museum for a market if it rains.
My partner Joost turns 40 next month and he's really into vinyl. Gift ideas under 150 euros?
He already has a good turntable, so no hardware.
My chain keeps slipping when I push hard uphill out of a tunnel. Is it the chain or the cassette?
Google Sheets formula to sum column C only where column A says 'print' and column B is in the current month?
And a version that groups the totals by month?
Suggest a 15 km running route around Utrecht for my long run on Sunday.
Mostly along the water, if possible.
Slept terribly and I've got back-to-back meetings today. Give me a 10-minute reset I can do at my desk.
Give me 10 Spanish sentences with the preterite, answers hidden at the bottom.
Now the same ten in Portuguese so I can compare.
